title: Optimize cross-service dependency graph and introduce slim Docker path
creator: Ari Patel
description:
Background: Our monorepo has accumulated cross-service dependency churn and oversized Docker base layers that slow CI, increase image churn, and make local iteration painful. This ticket aims to: 1) prune and rationalize runtime and dev dependencies across services to reduce install time and transitive updates; 2) define and implement a "slim Docker path" pattern that produces minimal runtime images and explicit developer fast-path images; 3) centralize lint/toolchain runners into a reproducible container to reduce duplicate tool installs in CI jobs.
Goals/Success criteria: - Reduce average CI image build time (warm cache) by 25% on core services. - Reduce Docker layer churn (measured by changed bytes between builds) by 30%. - Cut median yarn/pip install time in CI by 40% for service-level pipelines. - Provide a documented developer flow for the slim path that preserves local debug speed.
Scope and approach: - Dependency audit: automated analysis to surface top transitive dependencies and duplicate versions across services. We'll add a dependency-report job that outputs per-service dependency trees and size estimates. - Introduce "layered Docker profiles": base-runtime (minimal, pinned system deps), developer-dev (includes compilers, test tools), and ci-cache-warm (for ephemeral CI priming). Each service will declare which profile it uses. - Replace ad-hoc apt/apt-get patterns with a minimal, shared base image and a small set of trusted asset layers (openssl, ca-certificates, tzdata). - Centralize lint/toolchain into a fixed tag docker image (internal registry) used by all lint/test steps to avoid per-job installs. - Build cache heuristics: add a classifier that prefers cache keys based on lockfile changes and Dockerfile stable layers; TTL policy for cached layers to avoid staleness.
Rollout plan: 1) Prototype for two non-critical services (auth-proxy, metrics-ingest) and validate metrics. 2) Gradual rollout to platform and inference services with canary flag gated by pipeline variable. 3) Migrate developer docs and add migration script to update Dockerfile snippets.
Data and measurement: - CI job metrics (build duration, cache hit rate) from CircleCI/GitHub Actions dashboards. - Image sizes and layer diffs using dive and registry HTTP layer size APIs. - Install step timing captured by wrapper scripts.
Risks and mitigations: - Risk: Subtle change in base libs could affect runtime behavior. Mitigation: run full integration suite in canary before promoting. - Risk: Developer friction from two-image flow. Mitigation: maintain a simple alias script (dev-run) and docs.
Artifacts and links: - Dep-audit report (GDrive): https://drive.company.com/dep-audit/ENG-632918 - Prototype PR (auth-proxy): https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-proxy/pull/218 - Central lint image (registry): registry.redwood/cicd/lint:2026-03-01 - Measurement dashboard (Grafana): https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/ci-builds/ci-build-times
comments: 2026-02-12 — Kickoff: scoped to dependency audit + two-service prototype. Agreed to avoid changes to runtime semantics in prototype; focus on build/tooling only.
2026-02-18 — Dependency audit job added: outputs CSV per-service and flagged 12 high-impact transitive libraries (many devDeps duplicated across packages).

2026-02-23 — Prototype Docker profiles defined: base-runtime, developer-dev, ci-cache-warm. Auth-proxy updated to use base-runtime + multi-stage build for dev artifacts. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/auth-proxy/pull/218
2026-03-01 — First prototype results: auth-proxy image size down 38%, CI yarn install time down 45% on warm cache. Noted flaky integration test in metrics-ingest after base upgrade; investigating.
2026-03-05 — Code review feedback: lockfile-based cache key acceptance needs stronger validation. Added test harness to simulate lockfile changes and verify cache hits/misses.
2026-03-09 — Central lint image built and published (tag 2026-03-01). Replaced three repo-level lint jobs to reference registry image; initial savings: ~90s per lint job.
2026-03-11 — Metrics-ingest integration flake traced to minor version bump in transitive XML parser. Rolled back to pinned version in devDeps; added integration smoke test to CI gate.
2026-03-12 — Planning next sprint: expand to 6 more services, add TTL policy for cache keys, and draft migration guide for engineering teams. Estimate updated to 5 points.
Reviewer note (2026-03-12) — PM @Lena Ortiz: please include release notes template and training session for on-call/infra teams when rolling out change to platform services.
